title: Atomic Mass, Gram Atom & Isotopes
notes:
Gram Atom & Average Atomic Mass

1 gram atom = 1 mole atom = 6.022 × 10²³ atoms.

Formula: No. of gram atoms = Given weight (g) ÷ Atomic mass.
Average Atomic Mass: Weighted sum of isotope abundances (e.g. Cl: 35.5 amu, B: 10.81 amu).
summary: Gram atom, Avogadro's constant, and isotopic weighted averages.
